groups.saying_opens: ثم عرج بي حتى ظهرت لمستوى

notes: Taḥwīl «ح» joins two routes of the first saying (Abdan and Ahmad b. Salih); each writes its own names, so the Anas-Abu Dhar tail is written in both (shared_tail null because sayings are labelled, rule 4a)
«وأخبرني ابن حزم أن ابن عباس وأبا حبة الأنصاري كانا يقولان» is a second isnad for a later part of the same report: stored as saying 2
«قال ابن حزم وأنس بن مالك» is a third isnad for the fifty-prayers part: stored as saying 3
Anas's own narration inside the matn («قال أنس فذكر», «وقال أنس فلما مر جبريل») continues saying 1's route and is not a new isnad
